# Laya Meet

> Laya Meet (https://layameet.com) is an enterprise-grade, real-time AI bilingual video conferencing and live translation platform designed to eliminate language barriers in multinational business meetings.

## Overview
Laya Meet enables participants across the globe to speak in their native tongue while others receive live translated subtitles and speech in their preferred language with ultra-low latency (<350ms). Unlike generic video conferencing tools, Laya Meet is engineered specifically for cross-border collaboration between languages such as Vietnamese, Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean.

## Core Capabilities
- **Ultra-Low Latency Speech Recognition**: Powered by optimized `faster-whisper` (int8 quantization) with Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and 350ms browser audio chunking, providing ~964ms Time to First Subtitle (TTFS).
- **Any-to-Any Multilingual Matrix**: Supports simultaneous multilingual rooms with 50+ languages. Each participant selects their own subtitle language independently without affecting others.
- **Enterprise Privacy & RAM-Only Security**: 100% in-memory processing. Raw audio chunks are transcribed in RAM and instantly purged. Zero audio files or biometric voice recordings are stored on disk.
- **Laya Sidecar Intelligence**: An asynchronous background analysis worker that extracts key decisions, action items, and generates downloadable bilingual meeting minutes without blocking real-time subtitle delivery.
- **On-Premise & Air-Gapped Deployment**: Available for enterprise private clouds with full Docker/Kubernetes and zero external cloud API dependencies.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Community (Free)**: Up to 40 minutes per meeting, live dual-subtitles, core language pairs.
- **Team Pro (399,000 VND / ~16 USD / month)**: Unlimited meeting duration, custom enterprise glossary, priority low-latency translation queue, AI meeting minutes export.
- **Enterprise On-Premises (Custom SLA)**: Dedicated air-gapped server deployment, custom Whisper model fine-tuning, SAML/SSO integration, 99.9% uptime SLA.
